If you haven't played any of them, you should. They are all pretty fucking good with amazing art and music. Bastion's combat is fun, as is the narrator, and I loved the story. Dying Light(not the expansion) 11'99 60%

Parkour game on a city with zombies and scavenging. Amazing game, though it's really fucking disgusting. If you don't like gore or zombies then don't get it. Exploring the city is quite fun.
The day is pretty fun, with the really dumb zombies you can kick around, going around looting buildings.
The night is scary, you don't see shit, the common zombies become smarter and they can become running ones, and there are uber powerful zombies roaming around.
It's tense, going around looting or doing quests while trying to not be seen or heard by the volatiles. And it's really fucking intense when a volatile sees you and you have to get to a safehouse. Quite good.
I however didn't like the expansion at all, it's not the same game. Instead of being in the city parkouring you are in the countryside with a buggy, instead of melee and various tricks you just use guns. Not fun at all.
